subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Instant Centers: The Pivot That Moves
description: Learn Instant Centers: The Pivot That Moves in one minute.

hook.text: At any instant, every moving link rotates about a point — even if it shifts.

buildup.text: That point is the instant center. It's the momentary pivot of the motion.

discovery.text: Finding instant centers reveals velocity relationships between all links.

twist.text: Some instant centers sit outside the mechanism, floating in empty space.

climax.text: Car suspension geometry is designed around instant center placement.

punchline.text: Every moving body pivots somewhere, even if the pivot drifts.

quiz.question: What is an instant center?
options: A permanent pivot bolted to the frame of the mechanism
The momentary point about which a link is rotating at any instant
The center of mass of the moving link
